SOIL 501.title: Advanced Soil Processes
SOIL 501.description: Integrating the environmental factors influencing soil-forming processes and their ecological implications.

SOIL 502.title: Advanced Sustainable Soil Management
SOIL 502.description: Integration of fundamental, unifying, soil science principles in sustainable ecosystem management.

SOIL 503.title: Advanced Soil Sampling, Analyses and Data Interpretation
SOIL 503.description: Field and laboratory analytical techniques in the chemical, biological and physical assessment of soils.

SOIL 512.title: Advanced Soil Biology
SOIL 512.description: Current research in root-soil interfaces. Offered in alternate years.

SOIL 513.title: Advanced Soil Physics
SOIL 513.description: Infiltration and evaporation of water, flow and storage of heat and chemicals in soil, and interactions with the atmosphere. Emphasis on mathematical formulation of problems and solutions using analytical and numerical methods.

SOIL 514.title: Biometeorology
SOIL 514.description: Energy and mass exchange in the biosphere with emphasis on the interfaces between the atmosphere and soils, plants and animals. Offered in alternate years.

SOIL 515.title: Watershed Science
SOIL 515.description: Watershed evaluation, key aspects of hydrology, water quality, land use impacts on water resources and integration of multiple land use activities and their cumulative impacts.

SOIL 516.title: Urban Watershed Management
SOIL 516.description: Urbanization impacts on water resources with a focus on rainwater management, water quality, point and non-point sources of pollution, drinking water and waste water, riparian buffer zones, cumulative effects, and application of beneficial management practices.

SOIL 517.title: Land and Water Resource Evaluation
SOIL 517.description: Topics in land and water system evaluations and assessing resource development options; monitoring and modelling environmental systems.

SOIL 518.title: Water in International Development
SOIL 518.description: Key water issues associated with international development: global water demand, scarcity, efficiency of use, water as a commodity, biophysical and policy aspects of water management, water and health, land use impact, water harvesting, improved irrigation, and pollution prevention.

SOIL 520.title: Agricultural Watershed Management
SOIL 520.description: Intensive and extensive agriculture with a focus on water needs, water use, and impacts on water resources. Non-point sources of pollution, nutrient modelling, soil and land degradation, protection, and rehabilitation of watersheds including buffer zones, wetlands, and best management practices.

SOIL 524.title: Instrumentation for Biometeorology
SOIL 524.description: The theory, design and evaluation of instrumentation for biometeorological research.
